subject.title: improve(chat): make prose and simple lists one selectable text block

question: Should the tray retain and extend the bespoke FunctionalUI layer with this `RichTextBlock` primitive for the chat-selection improvement, or should this work wait for an agreed UI-framework direction?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing capability and expands the in-house UI abstraction; the linked architecture follow-up identifies a competing direction, so code review cannot establish the durable product and ownership choice alone.

options.title: Sponsor the focused primitive
options.body: Accept `RichTextBlock` as a narrow supported FunctionalUI seam after current-head native selection evidence demonstrates the stated UX contract.

options.title: Defer to UI-framework planning
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether the broader FunctionalUI-to-Reactor direction should own new control primitives.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the focused primitive
recommendation.body: Accept `RichTextBlock` as a narrow supported FunctionalUI seam after current-head native selection evidence demonstrates the stated UX contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer set the concrete proof contract and is the strongest available signal of the product/review boundary in the supplied discussion.
